entries.34a71342c78bfcdb: The GU business operated in Japan and overseas. This business sells low-priced casual apparel under the GU brand; revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥330,701 million.
entries.3de531d770eed77a: Casual apparel under the UNIQLO brand
entries.4de12a61e20f61eb: A company that plans casual clothing under brands such as "UNIQLO" and "GU" and sells it through its own stores and the internet.
entries.6e9f988060b67bf8: A business that operates “COMPTOIR DES COTONNIERS” mainly in France. In 2005, it acquired management control of NELSON FINANCES S.A.S. (now COMPTOIR DES COTONNIERS S.A.S.) and made it a subsidiary.
entries.771706317c974de0: A business that brings together brands other than UNIQLO and GU, conducting apparel planning, sales and manufacturing in Japan and overseas, among other activities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥131,542 million.
entries.91c2ab039d878bfd: Casual apparel under the GU brand
entries.94b01afe3cc7c30f: The UNIQLO business operated in Japan. It sells casual apparel under the UNIQLO brand within Japan. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,026,096 million.
entries.bfd9a7b397a3b803: A business handling apparel under the “Theory” brand. In 2004, the company invested in Link Holdings Co., Ltd. (now Link Theory Japan Co., Ltd.), which operates “Theory,” and in 2009 made it a subsidiary through a tender offer.
entries.e4977bd84b689212: The UNIQLO business operated overseas. It sells casual apparel under the UNIQLO brand in countries and regions outside Japan. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,910,289 million, the largest of the four reportable segments.
entries.f676903a25df346e: A business not included in reportable segments, such as real estate leasing. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,910 million.
entries.fc7bdbb426128341: A business that operates the French lingerie brand “PRINCESSE TAM.TAM.” In 2006, it acquired shares in PETIT VEHICULE S.A.S. (now PRINCESSE TAM.TAM S.A.S.) and made it a subsidiary.
entries.ff3d03bb81075d32: An apparel business operated by PLST Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary.
